Because the batch covers 17 January (month 17 is impossible) and fits the one-day-lag pattern of the other batches, the strings can be parsed as day-first without ambiguity.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED');"}}
